definitions: An individual person, animal, or thing belonging to a group or set.
A part of a whole, especially a part of the body or a structural component.
A person who has joined an organisation, society, or team.
A person elected or appointed to a parliament or similar assembly.
examples: He is a member of the club.
The leg is a lower member of the body.
Each member of the team contributed.
She is a Member of Parliament.
